exposure: delivery mode of the present birth
cohort: The study included 150 Chinese women hospitalized with threatened preterm labour who were approached 1 week after delivery.
finding: Self-perceived burden (SPB) and early postpartum depressive disorders are prevalent among Chinese women hospitalized with threatened preterm labour, and SPB, particularly its emotional aspect, is a strong predictor of early postpartum depressive disorders.
mod_finding: The delivery mode of the present birth was identified as a significant factor predicting early postpartum depressive symptoms.
